subject: Where are they now
author: Lofty_1783
body:
Chris Barrie does lots of documentaries about planes, wars and other such stuff from the discovery/science channels. Danny John Jules has been in loads of stuff. For example, he's in Lock, Stock & two smoking barrels... aw hell, just use www.imdb.com and check all 5 of them out (6 if you include Hilly AND Holly)

Dave the scutter was actually the third winner of the UK lottery winning a rollover of £764 million. Since then, he has actually started up the Jupiter Mining Corp for real and is hiring from a small office just off the A42 near Stroud.

you are probably now dumber for having read this!
